    ladder_patches = image_patch.find("ladder")
    firetruck_patches = image_patch.find("firetruck")
    
    if not ladder_patches or not firetruck_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    firetruck_depth = firetruck_patches[0].compute_depth()
    on_firetruck = [l for l in ladder_patches if abs(l.compute_depth() - firetruck_depth) < 0.1]
    
    return on_firetruck[0] if on_firetruck else ladder_patches[0]
